meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord, Mr Alvarez, about the broken heating in apartment 4B and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes. To: landlord@example.com; Subject: Heating not working in apartment 4B; the body starts "Dear Mr. Alvarez," and is signed Alex. A tone switch between Polite and Firm rewrites the body: the Polite one asks "Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?", the Firm one says "Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out." Send and Discard buttons; Send needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows "Sent to" the address with the subject and the body as it was sent.
meta.text:
state to="landlord@example.com"
state subject="Heating not working in apartment 4B"
state tone="Polite"
state sent=false
let ask = tone == "Firm" ? "Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out." : "Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?"
let text = "Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. " + ask + "\n\nThank you,\nAlex"

ChatCard "New email" "To Mr Alvarez" icon:"mail" status:"Draft" w:390
  if sent == false
    InputField "To" "landlord@example.com" =to
    InputField "Subject" "Subject" =subject
    Segments =tone options:["Polite","Firm"]
    InputField "Body" "" =text lines:8
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Discard" quiet -> emit discard
      ActionButton "Send" primary enabled:{to != "" and subject != ""} -> sent=true; toast "Email sent"
  if sent
    Receipt "Email sent" "Sent to {to}" tone:good icon:"check"
    Details rows:[["Sent to",to],["Subject",subject]]
    Paragraph "{text}"

delta: when a repair will be carried
